note: This FNS section describes QC audit methodology for examining earned income in the third effective month or later after a certification action. The Comparison I and II tests, error determinant month identification, fluctuating income analysis, and 30-day reporting timeframe adjustments are all procedures for QC reviewers auditing cases after the fact — not caseworker eligibility or budgeting procedures. The $125 threshold here is part of the QC comparison test (difference between QC-verified income and EW income), not the household change reporting threshold. The OLG appropriately covers the caseworker-facing aspects: earned income verification at interim report, the $125 unearned income reporting threshold, and prospective budgeting procedures. No OLG coverage of QC audit methodology is expected or needed.
